autofill.passwords_hint: Logins saved in the encrypted vault
autofill.payments_hint: Cards you can fill in at checkout
autofill.payments_description: Cards are kept in the encrypted vault. The security code (CVV) is never saved: you type it on the site. Opening a card asks for your master password or Windows Hello.
autofill.contacts_description: Contact details are kept in the encrypted vault and can fill in forms for you.
autofill.card_cvv_note: The security code is not saved.
autofill.error_invalid: Check the fields: a card needs a valid number, month and year; contact info needs at least one field and a valid email.
